quote: Proposition 4. Let X1 having the cdf given by (2) with p = p1 and X2 having the cdf given by (2) with p = p2. Then, if p1 <= p2, we have X1 <=lr X2 (implying X1 <=hr X2 and X1 <=st X2). The equality in the likelihood ratio order is satisfied if and only if p1 = p2.
family: OEL-G (odd exponential-logarithmic) focds: F(x; p, beta, xi) = 1 - (1/log p) log[1 - (1-p) exp(-beta G(x;xi)/(1-G(x;xi)))], p in (0,1), beta > 0
compared: two OEL-G variables differing only in the parameter p (p1 vs p2), common beta and baseline G

hypotheses.formal: ordering of the EL parameter p only

conclusion.direction: X1 <=_lr X2 (hence X1 <=_hr X2 and X1 <=_st X2); equality iff p1 = p2

quantifiers: x in R; p1, p2 in (0,1), beta > 0
